newsitem.title: USA: Amway Asia says completes tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Amway Asia says completes tender offer.

text.p: Amway Asia Pacific Ltd said Tuesday it intends to purchase all of the 3,681,857 shares that were tendered at $40.875 per common share as part of its previously announced tender offer which expired Friday.
Amway Asia said it had commenced the offer to purchase up to 3,500,000 common shares on April 28, 1997.

Under the terms of the offer, however, the company said it may purchase up to an additional two percent of the shares outstanding without extending the offer. Accordingly, it intends to purchase all shares tendered and not withdrawn.

The company expects to purchase under the offer an aggregate of 1,997,648 shares of common stock from the two foundations established by its principal shareholders and 972,222 shares of stock from Amway Japan Ltd, an affiliate of Amway Asia.

Giving effect to this purchase, immediately following the offer, the principal shareholders will beneficially own, in the aggregate, approximately 85.0 percent of the outstanding common stock and Amway Japan will no longer own any shares.
The 3,681,857 shares that the company expects to purchase represent approximately 6.1 percent of the common stock outstanding prior to the offer.
Amway Asia, headquartered in Hong Kong, is the exclusive distribution vehicle for Amway Corp in Australia, Brunei, China, Hong Kong, Macau, Malaysia, New Zealand, Taiwan and Thailand.
Amway Corp sells Amway consumer products through a distribution network of approximately 555,000 independent distributors.
